(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second, and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flanges extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second, and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive comprising an epoxy-based structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas into interfacial layers between the members.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive comprising an epoxy-based structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, and the layer of adhesive comprises a sheet of structural adhesive.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are laminated composite structures.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and an adhesive layer joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
